statement_made: Effort is going to outlast skill every time. I’m going to give 100 percent whether I’ve got the call or I don’t.
event_description: Describing the 'relentless edge' he brings to the Dolphins' secondary during his introductory press conference.

statement_made: Chris (Johnson) plays with an edge. He is non-stop and relentless, and that’s the culture we are building here.
event_description: Dolphins GM explaining why the team traded up to draft cornerback Chris Johnson.

statement_made: We want guys that have versatility. Max (Llewellyn) has a toughness to him that we really liked throughout this process.
event_description: Dolphins Head Coach discussing the Day 3 selection of Max Llewellyn.

statement_made: Bobby (Jamison Travis) and JC (Davis) are two guys we had in on visits. We're fired up to finally get them on the roster.
event_description: Giants GM reflecting on the long wait between picks and the players they eventually landed on Day 2.

statement_made: We have a bunch of Giants, figuratively and literally. We wanted to be bigger and more physical, and we achieved that.
event_description: Giants Head Coach discussing the physical profile of the 2026 draft class.

statement_made: I’m a determined guy. I want to come in and show that I can contribute to this receiving corps right away.
event_description: Introductory remarks after being selected by the New York Giants.

statement_made: Being the first pick is an honor, but the work starts now. I’m ready to lead this Raiders offense.
event_description: Draft night interview after being selected No. 1 overall by the Las Vegas Raiders.

statement_made: I’m coming to the edge with everything I’ve got. Ready to make an impact for the Raiders defense.
event_description: Reacting to his No. 2 overall selection by the Las Vegas Raiders.

statement_made: Green Bay is where I want to be. Grateful to the organization for believing in me with this extension.
event_description: Commenting on his 3-year, $50M contract extension with the Packers.

statement_made: The star looks good on me. Time to go to work in Big D.
event_description: Social media post after signing his franchise tag with the Dallas Cowboys.

statement_made: Jacksonville is home. I’m happy to get this deal done so we can focus on winning a championship.
event_description: Addressing his 4-year, $110M extension with the Jaguars.

statement_made: I love this city and this team. Let’s keep building something special in Seattle.
event_description: Reacting to his massive 4-year contract extension with the Seahawks.

statement_made: Ready to bring that Big Ten physicality to Foxborough. I’m a workhorse, and I’m ready to get after it.
event_description: First public reaction after being selected by the New England Patriots in the second round.

statement_made: Playing for Brian Flores is a dream come true for a linebacker. I’m ready to fly around in this defense.
event_description: Discussing his fit with the Vikings after being selected in the second round.

statement_made: I might be smaller, but I play big. The Jets are getting a dog who won't back down from anyone.
event_description: Addressing concerns about his size after being drafted by the New York Jets.

statement_made: New start, same goals. Ready to help the Saints get back to the top of the NFC South.
event_description: First public comment after being traded from the Raiders to the New Orleans Saints during the draft.

statement_made: Decisions are part of the business. My focus remains on being the best linebacker for the Lions this season.
event_description: Addressing the media after the Lions declined his fifth-year option.

statement_made: Excited to join the Cowboys and help this offense take the next step. Ready to go to work.
event_description: Commenting on his one-year signing with Dallas in late April.

statement_made: Grateful for the chance in San Fran. Ready to compete and earn my spot on this roster.
event_description: Reflecting on signing a free-agent deal with the 49ers.

statement_made: Fernando Mendoza is a maestro playing the notes on the page. He lacks improvisational talent but is mechanically sound.
event_description: NFL Analyst providing a final evaluation of the Raiders' No. 1 overall pick.
